name: Stillwater Pond
summary: At Stillwater Pond, gray water and skeletal fish mark the loss of a place where Lordaeron's children once swam. Dangerous scavengers prowl its western shore, just west of Brill.

sections.title: A Ruined Respite
sections.body: Stillwater Pond once drew families from nearby hamlets for picnics on its grassy banks. Before the Third War and the Plague of Undeath, its shallows gave children too young to brave Brightwater Lake a place to learn to swim. The water is now lifeless and gray. The living have vanished, leaving skeletal fish beneath the surface and wandering undead in the surrounding woods.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Mist
sections.body: Stillwater Pond is quieter than Tirisfal's besieged roads and contested farms, but danger lingers along its shore. Blighted beasts drink from its murky water, including Bayne, a ferocious darkhound that stalks the banks. Travelers crossing the western meadows toward Brill must watch for predatory beasts and aimless zombies by the water's edge.

faq.q: What was Stillwater Pond like before the Plague?
aliases: what was stillwater pond used for
faq.answer: Before the Plague, Stillwater Pond drew local families for picnics in human Lordaeron. Its shallows were calmer than Brightwater Lake, so parents brought young children there to swim.

faq.q: Is there anything living in the water now?
faq.answer: No normal aquatic life survived Tirisfal's blighting. Only animated, skeletal fish swim beneath the gray surface, left by the Scourge's corruption.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures wander near the pond?
faq.answer: Mindless undead wander the glades, and Bayne is the shore's most notorious threat. The unusually powerful, aggressive darkhound feeds on unwary travelers.
Stillwater Pond lies in central Tirisfal Glades, directly west of Brill and southwest of Brightwater Lake.

angles.text: As a Forsaken who remembers life in Lordaeron, Stillwater Pond may recall childhood days spent picnicking and swimming along its once-clear banks.
As a hunter, you face blighted wildlife around the pond, including feral darkhounds like Bayne. The shore is hazardous hunting ground for scouts patrolling Brill's outskirts.
